boundary: build-only background candidate; parent heldout beams and known Actor trajectories unchanged; no new-log quality evaluation

manifest.input_selection: same parent build sweeps, valid sensor poses, outside every valid-time known box+0.1m; no sensor-near removal or input cap
manifest.endpoints: published reference-ego compensated xyz transformed to world once; never apply per-point ego transform again to these endpoints
manifest.origins: actual calibrated per-return world sensor origins; group exact identical float64 origins without time/position quantization or frame-origin substitution
manifest.grouping: sort/partition once; preserve point order within each origin group; no repeated N-by-number-of-origins scan
manifest.integration_weights: one unit per retained original return; parent PCA deduplicates float32 endpoints, so raw integration count can differ from its unique center count
manifest.unknown_boundary: all 8 meshing-cell corners observed; no unknown-region closure or learned opacity
manifest.carving: reuse common one-pass whole-triangle exclusion before all original build first-return ranges minus0.2m, with the same per-return origins
manifest.readout_inputs: parent heldout beams, owners, sensor-known flags and readonly Actor trajectories linked unchanged; heldout values not evaluated or read for fusion

carving.approximation: whole triangle removal; one all-returned-intersections pass, coincident BVH hits can be coalesced
